layout.page_container: flex flex-col gap-8 p-6 lg:p-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full

cards.stat_wrapper: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-gray-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 flex flex-col gap-3
cards.stat_label: flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500

inputs.filter_bar: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3 p-1.5 bg-gray-50/50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl
inputs.search: flex h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0B2C5F]/20 focus:border-[#0B2C5F] transition-all shadow-sm
inputs.select: flex h-10 items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0B2C5F]/20 focus:border-[#0B2C5F] shadow-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors
inputs.ghost_title: w-full resize-none appearance-none overflow-hidden bg-transparent text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none
inputs.ghost_textarea: w-full min-h-[160px] resize-none appearance-none bg-transparent text-base text-gray-700 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none leading-relaxed

lists.container: rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden
lists.row: group relative flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-gray-100 bg-white p-4 transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-gray-50/80 cursor-pointer last:border-0
lists.row_urgent: before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:left-0 before:w-1.5 before:bg-red-500 before:rounded-r-full bg-red-50/10
lists.row_unread_dot: absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 ring-4 ring-white

modals.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-gray-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity
modals.content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 w-full max-w-3xl translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-[0_24px_48px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.18)] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden duration-200 sm:rounded-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]
modals.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 bg-white flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-10
modals.body_scroll: p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex flex-col gap-6
modals.footer: px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 sticky bottom-0 z-10

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#0B2C5F] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-[#082046] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0B2C5F]/50 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gray-200 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gray-200 transition-colors
buttons.danger: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-red-700 shadow-sm hover:bg-red-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500/50 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all

chat.container: flex flex-col gap-5 p-5 bg-gray-50/50 rounded-xl border border-gray-100
chat.bubble_sent: self-end max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[75%] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm bg-[#0B2C5F] px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-1
chat.bubble_received: self-start max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[75%] rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-800 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-1

chips.category_base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer

radio_cards.base: relative flex cursor-pointer rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-sm focus:outline-none transition-all

global_rules: ALL text labels MUST be in Spanish (Perú).
MANDATORY: Preserve all existing `data-testid` attributes exactly as they are.

Do NOT replace the main header (`DashboardHeader`) or sidebar components.
